title: Rephrase, Augment, Reason: Visual Grounding of Questions for Vision-Language Models

layout.note: A dotted horizontal rule splits the figure. Above: a tennis photo at the left feeds a dashed grey LVLM box holding a robot, a wrench and a green loop; to its right the original-question lane (red, cross) sits above the modified-question lane (green, check) on either side of a VQA Prompt label. Below: two aligned examples, each running left to right from photo and original question through a RepARe wrench to the modified question and answer.

lesson: Show a text-editing method on real inputs: the same photo beside the original and the rewritten prompt, a red cross against a green check at the answers, and the inserted phrases coloured like the details that produced them so the fix can be traced; then repeat the same icon grammar in a lower row of smaller examples.
